title: Fix probe CLI tenant binding and sealed preflight failure evidence

not_changing: Product tenant authorization or BFF 403 enforcement
Hosted runtime write permissions or live trading brokers
Prior causal receipt guards, durable reload, or lineage discovery
composes_with: PR #5602 (Loop 8 and 9 RuntimeBinding and paper lifecycle probe)

acceptance_matrix.criterion: CLI must bind explicit tenant or configured PANTHEON_TENANT_ID without a truthy default shadowing it; reject missing tenant for authenticated owner probes
acceptance_matrix.evidence: ProbeConfig.tenant_id defaults to None instead of 'default', preventing truthy shadowing of environment PANTHEON_TENANT_ID. CLI parse_args provides --tenant-id with PANTHEON_TENANT_ID fallback and explicit CLI override. Authenticated requests without tenant fail closed with typed MissingTenantError.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Read-only hosted preflight must send correct authenticated tenant and no POST mutations; verify 403 failures produce sealed failed or blocked evidence not an uncaught exception with no file
acceptance_matrix.evidence: run_preflight executes only read-only GET requests (zero POST/PUT/DELETE mutations). Unexpected 403 status raises TenantAccessDeniedError (inheriting PreflightBlockedError) and is caught by probe.run(), sealing and persisting blocked evidence to output_path in finally without an uncaught exception.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Tests cover CLI to ProbeConfig to Authorization and X-Tenant-Id request binding plus typed failure persistence
acceptance_matrix.evidence: scripts/test_probe_dev_runtime_paper_lifecycle.py expanded from 42 to 53 unit and function pipeline tests, validating CLI arguments, env fallback, precedence, MissingTenantError rejection, 403 sealed evidence persistence, and main() exit codes (0 for success, 2 for blocked).

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Retain no dummy credentials no static FE token forwarding no real writes and all prior causal receipt guards
acceptance_matrix.evidence: All dummy credentials remain removed; static FE requests (/deployment.json) never receive Authorization or tenant headers; real capital/order write guards in _enforce_paper_safety remain strict; Loop 8 inbox receipts, Loop 9 trade episodes, and durable reload verifications remain fully intact.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Deliver DRAFT exact-head PR to dev with focused tests; root alone marks ready integrates and deploys
acceptance_matrix.evidence: DRAFT pull request targeted at dev will be opened with exact frozen head; root owns readiness marking, integration, and dev deployment.

review_decision.note: Independent reviewer must validate the exact frozen PR head, test coverage, and this manifest before approval.

delivery.note: PR opened as DRAFT; Root owns readiness review and integration.

non_actions: No hosted write probes were executed; root owns integration and dev deployment.
No live capital, real trading, or live broker execution was enabled.
No product tenant authorization was altered or loosened.
No changes made to BFF service code or deployment release controller.
